email.subject: Reset your password
email.intro: We received a request to reset your password for your account.
email.instructions: Click the button above to reset your password. This link will expire in 30 minutes for security reasons.
email.no_action: If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password will remain unchanged.
email.security_note: For your security, this request was made from IP address: {ip}
email.help: If you're having trouble with the button above, copy and paste the URL below into your web browser:

email.subject: Confirm your email address
email.intro: Thanks for signing up! Confirm that this is your email address to finish creating your account.
email.instructions: Click the button above to confirm your email address. You can sign in as soon as it's confirmed.
email.no_action: If you didn't create an account, you can safely ignore this email - nobody can sign in with this address until it's confirmed.
email.security_note: For your security, this request was made from IP address: {ip}
email.help: If you're having trouble with the button above, copy and paste the URL below into your web browser:

email.subject: Confirm your email to finish signing in
email.intro: Someone signed in with an account that didn't share a verified email address, and asked to use this one. Confirm it's yours to finish signing in.
email.instructions: Open the link in the same browser where you started signing in. It won't work anywhere else.
email.no_action: If this wasn't you, ignore this email. Nobody can use your address without this link.
email.security_note: For your security, this request was made from IP address: {ip}

warning_issued.label: Warnings from moderators

warning_issued.title_reason: You received a warning for {reason} ({points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}})

warning_revoked.title: A warning was revoked
warning_revoked.body: Its {points, plural, one {# point no longer counts} other {# points no longer count}} against your account.

account_suspended.label: Account suspensions
account_suspended.description: When your account is suspended after reaching a warning limit.
account_suspended.title: Your account is suspended
account_suspended.body_until: You can use your account again after {endsAt} (UTC).
account_suspended.body_indefinite: Your account is suspended until a moderator lifts it.

suspension_revoked.label: Lifted suspensions
suspension_revoked.description: When a moderator lifts a suspension of your account.
suspension_revoked.title: A suspension was lifted
suspension_revoked.body: A moderator lifted a suspension of your account. Check your account status to see if anything else still applies.
